fixture_notice: UI STATE FIXTURES. No XRPL settlement is implemented or authorized at baseline a3ec0a3. None of these states was observed on any ledger; no transaction exists for any of them, and every hash, ledger index and result field is deliberately null.

states.label: Not submitted
states.meaning: No XRPL transaction has been built, signed or submitted for this purchase. This is the real state of every purchase at baseline a3ec0a3.
states.operator_action: None. Accounting settlement, if any, is Credence's internal record only.

states.label: Pending confirmation
states.meaning: A signed transaction was submitted and is not yet in a validated ledger, and its last ledger sequence has not passed.
states.operator_action: Wait. Do not resubmit or treat the payment as made.

states.label: Validated: success
states.meaning: The transaction is in a validated ledger with a success result. Only this state would mean the provider payment is confirmed on XRPL.

states.label: Validated: failure
states.meaning: The transaction is in a validated ledger with a failure result. The fee may be consumed; the payment did not happen.
states.operator_action: Investigate the result code before any new transaction.

states.label: Expired: confirmed not included
states.meaning: The last ledger sequence has passed and validated ledgers through it show the transaction was not included. It can never be included.
states.operator_action: A new transaction may be prepared under a new policy decision.

states.label: Unknown: reconciliation required
states.meaning: Credence cannot establish whether the transaction was included (for example, contact lost before validation could be checked).
states.operator_action: Reconcile against validated ledger history. Do not resubmit or release anything until resolved.
